content: Insulin delivery pens, as recommended by the American Diabetes Association (ADA), are available in two main types: reusable pens and disposable pens. These pens are designed to accommodate different user needs. Some pens come with prefilled cartridges, which are ready for immediate use, while others are equipped with replaceable cartridges, allowing for continued use by replacing the insulin reservoir as needed. Additionally, certain insulin pens are equipped with connected capabilities, meaning they can transmit data electronically. This feature enables users and healthcare professionals to monitor insulin administration and make necessary adjustments to dosages based on the transmitted data, thereby optimizing diabetes management.
